maximum_depth_rule: All 114 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until vision, execution-plan, regional-plan, demographic-strategy, values, periods, units, and publication roles can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
hierarchy_boundary: The long-term vision toward 2040, the 2025-2029 execution plan, east and west regional plans, and the population-decline strategy remain separate planning layers. Three broad source-index regions and six regional-plan operating areas are not merged.
evaluation_boundary: Annual challenge goals and their results remain execution-review records and do not become an overall achievement judgment for the long-term vision.
non_goals: Do not fill the zero-row full-version document with inferred records.
Do not merge the long-term vision and execution plan into one target layer.
Do not merge three broad regions with six operating regions.
Do not treat annual challenge results as overall vision achievement.
Do not infer actuals or targets from contents pages or mixed raw text.
Do not replace missing units or split multiple values by inference.
Do not calculate causality or cross-prefecture ranking.
